questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Honeybees and Pollination?
choices: Honeybees share hive jobs and help flowering plants grow.
Only pollen sticks to bees and moves between flowers.
Only worker honeybees collect sugary nectar from flowers.
questions.answer: Honeybees share hive jobs and help flowering plants grow.
